Behind the scenes: the foundation for tag-based organization is in. Your plant varieties now automatically carry type and lifecycle tags (like pepper and annual) that will power smarter grouping and filtering in upcoming releases.

Plant varieties can now carry a crop type — pepper, tomato, basil, and 60+ more. When you add a new variety you'll pick its type, which keeps your collection tidy and sets up smarter grouping and care that's coming next.

🎉 Version 3.0 — the V3 milestone is complete. Everything from this development cycle is now live: the Doctor Gardener daily care plan, the Today view, photo-first capture, native Move/reorganize, household sharing, critters & rewards, and dozens of polish fixes. Next up: the V4 foundation — smarter tags and grouping, plus a fuller design refresh.

Snap → create: a new 📸 Snap button on Today and your Garden lets you take a photo and turn it straight into a new planting, a quick event log, an updated planting photo, or an inventory item — with Save & Next for logging several in a row.

Move plantings and projects safely: a new Move action reorganizes a project under a different parent in one step, with an instant Undo if you change your mind — and it now guards against accidental loops and two-device conflicts.
Photos page is sturdier: if something ever goes wrong drawing your photo gallery, the page now shows a clear message with a Retry button instead of going blank — the rest of the app keeps working.

Archived plantings can now be brought back: open an archived planting and tap Unarchive to restore it — the same way archived projects already work. Before this, once the brief Undo window passed an archived planting was hidden with no easy way to recover it.
Watering on hot days: on days around 85°F and up, the daily plan now knows fabric grow bags dry out fast, so a light rain won't make a thirsty bag look like it's been watered.
Photo Library: if your photos can't load, you now get a clear message with a Retry button instead of the page looking empty as if you had no photos.

Reliability: your watering alerts and the Today page are now protected against a rare internal data-format mismatch — if it ever happened they’d show an honest empty state instead of wrong or missing plants.
The dashboard is sturdier: if one section has a hiccup loading, the rest of the page still comes up instead of the whole screen failing.
Your watering alerts and the Today page now agree — the alert bar shows the same plants as your daily plan, so a plant won't say it needs water in one place but not the other.
Plants you've already watered, or that got enough rain today, now drop off the alert bar just like they do on Today.
Established plants in larger pots and bags (about 5 gallons and up) now get credit for recent rain instead of being treated as fragile new transplants that need watering anyway.
Today weather: the rain figure now refreshes live through the day instead of staying stuck on the pre-dawn reading — so showery days show the current amount, not the 2 AM guess
Today alerts now name the specific plant when a pot holds just one (e.g. “Dracaena needs water”) instead of its container
Weather: on showery days the rain amount is now flagged as a changeable pre-dawn snapshot, so the watering call stays honest
